item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00345","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C03","C18","C08"],"selected_candidate_label":"C03","confidence":0.78,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C03 plausibly supplied a compact drafting template for the child's central invitation: an invitation to meet at the White House to discuss urgent international problems confronting the country and the free world. The child materially expands that framework into a governors' conference with a program, presenters, and logistics. C18 is a strong secondary parallel because it links a conference, government officials' presentations, international and defense problems, and cooperation with leaders outside the federal government, but it does not itself organize or invite attendance at the conference. C08 shares conference-support language and federal-official participation but concerns resources and offers a less similar structure.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I extend to you and the Governors of the other States of the nation a most cordial invitation to attend a conference here in the White House ... for the purpose of participating in confidential discussions relating to problems facing America and the free world","parent_excerpt":"I invite you, therefore, to meet with me here in the White House ... to discuss the problems of this transition period ... particularly in view of the international dangers and problems that confront this country and the whole free world.","explanation":"Both use a presidential invitation to a White House meeting as the vehicle for discussing urgent problems confronting the country and the free world; the combination of setting, purpose, and language is concrete and material."},{"child_excerpt":"The program will give consideration ... to current developments in the field of international relations, the American defense effort, [and] the problems of national security","parent_excerpt":"particularly in view of the international dangers and problems that confront this country and the whole free world","explanation":"The child elaborates the parent's international-danger premise into a defined national-security and defense agenda."},{"child_excerpt":"America's leaders, State and national, working side by side ... [and] the full cooperation of each of you","parent_excerpt":"this Nation is united in its struggle for freedom and peace","explanation":"Both frame the proposed meeting as a means of demonstrating or producing unity and cooperation among national leaders in confronting international dangers."}]}
